scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.gen:manifest: pnpm build && oclif manifest && node scripts/sort-manifest.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build && MEILI_INTEGRATION=required vitest run --project integration-meilisearch

auth.description: Log in to Meilisearch Cloud, check the session, refresh it and log out.

batch.description: Batches of tasks the instance processed.

config.description: Projects of the config file, which holds API keys and decides where every command goes.

document.description: Documents of an index. The commands that write answer with a task: they print it and return at once, and --wait polls it to a final status instead. A delete command requires --yes.

index.description: Indexes of the instance. The commands that write answer with a task: they print it and return at once, and --wait polls it to a final status instead. A delete command requires --yes.

key.description: API keys of the instance. Each answer includes the `key` field, a working credential. A delete command requires --yes.

organization.description: Meilisearch Cloud organizations. A delete command requires --yes.

project.description: Meilisearch Cloud projects. A delete command requires --yes.

region.description: Meilisearch Cloud regions, where a project can run.

resource.description: Meilisearch Cloud resources, the plans a project runs on.

settings.description: Settings of an index. The commands that write answer with a task: they print it and return at once, and --wait polls it to a final status instead. A delete command requires --yes.

task.description: Tasks of the instance: what the instance did with each write, and what it still has to do. `cancel` and `delete` answer with a task: they print it and return at once, and --wait polls it to a final status instead. A delete command requires --yes.

team.description: Meilisearch Cloud teams. A delete command requires --yes.
